0022600208.text: The Denver Nuggets (5-3, 4th in the Northwest, 2 games back, 9th in the West, riding a two-game win streak) visit the Houston Rockets (7-3, 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back, 6th in the West, on a two-game losing streak) in Denver's 9th game of the season. Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain, while Aaron Gordon, Cameron Johnson, Christian Braun, DeRozan, Jamal Murray, and Nikola Jokic are all listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, and Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain), Oscar Tshiebwe (illness), and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Nuggets won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 129-93 win in Denver on March 11, 2026.
